001package bank.model;
002
003import java.security.MessageDigest;
004import java.security.NoSuchAlgorithmException;
005import java.util.ArrayList;
006import java.util.List;
007
008/**
009 * ============================================================================
010 *  Customer.java
011 *  Owner: Abdul Rahman Fornah (afornah1@umbc.edu)
012 * ============================================================================
013 *
014 *  REPRESENTS:
015 *      A bank customer who owns multiple accounts. This class manages the 
016 *      customer's profile, authentication security (hashed PINs, lockouts), 
017 *      and provides access to their account and transaction history.
018 *
019 *  SECURITY:
020 *      - PINs are never stored in plaintext. They are hashed using SHA-256.
021 *      - Implements a 3-strike lockout policy for failed login attempts.
022 * ============================================================================
023 */
024public class Customer {
025
026    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
027    // Fields. Gson reads these directly when loading from JSON, so the
028    // names here have to match what's in bank.json (talk to Person C).
029    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
030
031    private String id;                              // e.g. "1001"
032    private String name;                            // e.g. "Jane Doe"
033    private String pinHash;                         // SHA-256 hex of the PIN
034    private int failedLoginAttempts;
035    private boolean locked;
036    private List<Account> accounts = new ArrayList<>();
037    private List<Transaction> transactions = new ArrayList<>();
038
039    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
040    // Constructors
041    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
042
043    /** No-arg constructor required by Gson. Don't delete. */
044    protected Customer() { }
045
046    /**
047     * Initializes a new Customer.
048     * 
049     * @param id The unique customer ID.
050     * @param name The customer's full name.
051     * @param rawPin The initial PIN (will be hashed before storage).
052     */
053    public Customer(String id, String name, String rawPin) {
054        this.id = id;
055        this.name = name;
056        this.pinHash = hashPin(rawPin);
057        this.failedLoginAttempts = 0;
058        this.locked = false;
059    }
060
061    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
062    // PIN handling
063    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
064
065    /**
066     * Authenticates the customer by comparing the provided PIN with the stored hash.
067     * Also manages the failed attempt counter and account locking.
068     *
069     * @param rawPin The plaintext PIN provided by the user.
070     * @return true if the PIN is correct and the account is not locked; false otherwise.
071     */
072    public boolean verifyPin(String rawPin) {
073        if (this.locked) {
074            return false;
075        }
076
077        String hashedInput = hashPin(rawPin);
078        if (hashedInput.equals(this.pinHash)) {
079            this.failedLoginAttempts = 0;
080            return true;
081        } else {
082            this.failedLoginAttempts++;
083            if (this.failedLoginAttempts >= 3) {
084                this.locked = true;
085            }
086            return false;
087        }
088    }
089
090    /**
091     * Standard SHA-256 hex hash. Use this everywhere you touch a PIN.
092     */
093    public static String hashPin(String rawPin) {
094        try {
095            MessageDigest md = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256");
096            byte[] digest = md.digest(rawPin.getBytes("UTF-8"));
097            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
098            for (byte b : digest) sb.append(String.format("%02x", b));
099            return sb.toString();
100        } catch (NoSuchAlgorithmException | java.io.UnsupportedEncodingException e) {
101            throw new RuntimeException("PIN hashing failed", e);
102        }
103    }
104
105    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
106    // Account helpers
107    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
108
109    /**
110     * Retrieves an account owned by this customer by its ID.
111     *
112     * @param accountId The ID of the account to find.
113     * @return The Account object if found; null otherwise.
114     */
115    public Account findAccount(String accountId) {
116        for (Account account : accounts) {
117            if (account.getId().equals(accountId)) {
118                return account;
119            }
120        }
121        return null;
122    }
123
124    /**
125     * Adds a new account to the customer's profile.
126     * 
127     * @param a The account to add.
128     */
129    public void addAccount(Account a) {
130        this.accounts.add(a);
131    }
132
133    /**
134     * Records a transaction in the customer's history.
135     * 
136     * @param t The transaction to record.
137     */
138    public void recordTransaction(Transaction t) {
139        this.transactions.add(t);
140    }
141
142    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
143    // Plain getters (Gson + everyone else needs these)
144    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
145
146    public String getId() { return id; }
147    public String getName() { return name; }
148    public boolean isLocked() { return locked; }
149    public int getFailedLoginAttempts() { return failedLoginAttempts; }
150    public List<Account> getAccounts() { return accounts; }
151    public List<Transaction> getTransactions() { return transactions; }
152
153    /**
154     * Unlocks the customer account and resets the failed login attempt counter.
155     */
156    public void unlock() {
157        this.locked = false;
158        this.failedLoginAttempts = 0;
159    }
160}
